# IPCs
[color=#ffa500]Warning! This species is not recommended for new players due to major gameplay changes![/color]
IPC (Placeholder text)
## Racial Features
- Receive [color=#8147ff]50% more shock damage[/color], [color=#FF3636]20% more blunt damage[/color] and [color=#B9BF93]30% less slash/piercing damage[/color]. - Deal [color=red]6[/color] blunt damage with your mighty fists of steel! - You can't be analysed by conventional health displays, needing diagnostic HUDs and other gear with built-in diagnostics to read you. - You don't need to eat or drink, but you do need to stay charged. You can take power directly from APC and substations or sit in a borg recharger- both work. - You're functionally immune to spacing, as temperature doesn't affect you and you don't need to breathe. You will still overheat in a vacuum, though. - Play music with your in-built MIDI synthesiser! - Chemicals don't work on you, and your "doctor" is a roboticist. Welding heals physical injuries, cables fix electrical damage, plasma fixes rads, and glass fixes your eyes. - You do not have "blood" in the conventional sense, instead using oil and relying on oil packs for refills. You do not need a lot of oil to stay functional, thankfully. - Your internals are delicate and any damage to them will reduce your functionality. [color=red]Your slowdown on damage is increased.[/color] - EMPs are [color=red]lethal[/color] to you! Don't let yourself get hit, or you'll run out of power and require manual rebooting. - Internal Headset! It has two slots. Choose wisely!
Helpful tip - You need to unlock your panel and then use a screwdriver to get access to your internals, this includes the comm keys! Once open, right click yourself and go to "Eject" - You'll then pull out the last key you put in.
